decisions.difference: A: (diagnosis Arthropathy possible) pre-screen on Pain of joint / Joint swelling / Joint stiffness  vs  B: (clinical_finding Pain of joint)
decisions.reason: The page names no arthropathy and no stiffness; Will's briefing says to use the most natural clinical_finding for an unrecorded complaint, and A's pre-screen is itself triggered by the same unrecorded findings, so it adds a diagnosis not on the page without improving anchoring.
The page says only 'injury ... and severe pain/swelling or deformity, fracture likely'; the deformity of a fracture need not be of the joint, so the generic concept matches the page's word.
Stiffness is not mentioned anywhere on the page.

decisions.difference: A: (Pain of joint) in check_for  vs  B: Pain of joint as trigger
decisions.reason: Follows the trigger decision; a task must not check for its own due_to finding.
